IdsM shall not call PduR_IdsMTransmit again before IdsM_TpTxConfirmation or IdsM_TxConfirmation have been called.
The IdsM shall receive the confirmation for the complete transmission of the IF upper layer Tx-Pdu by the PduR Module with the service IdsM_TxConfirmation .

The IdsM shall be able to transmit segmented PDUs with the service IdsM_CopyTxData . The function shall be called several times, each call to this function shall transmit a segment of the Tx-PDU , until it has been completely sent.
The IdsM shall receive the confirmation of the transmission of a segmented PDU by the PduR Module with the service IdsM_TpTxConfirmation .
{DRAFT} The IdsM shall provide a functionality for persisting on-board QSEvs, with their corresponding optional fields: context data and timestamp in Dem / Sem .
{DRAFT} The IdsM shall be able to use the sink Dem / Sem for the configured events. The Sem sink indicates that the corresponding QSEv shall be stored in the Dem 's user defined memory: Sem .
{DRAFT} The data stored in Dem / Sem is the complete IDS Message with its mandatory and optional fields.
The IdsM shall be able to persist the parameter "Reporting Mode" of a SEv in the NvM.

The write routine of the NvM block NvM_WriteBlock shall be triggered after the modification of a "Reporting Mode" value IdsMReportingModeFilter has been successfully changed by the diagnostic services.
If the persistence in the NvM block fails, the IdsM shall roll back the SEv 's "Reporting Mode" IdsMReportingModeFilter , to the value before the diagnostic modification.
The IdsM shall be able to read out the "Reporting Mode" IdsMReportingModeFilter persisted in the NvM for the corresponding SEvs handled by the IdsM instance.
In case there are no NvM values available for the "Reporting Mode" IdsMReportingModeFilter of the SEvs, the configured values provided in the configuration tool shall be used.
The NvM block descriptor referenced by IdsMNvmBlockDescriptor , shall be a block processed during NvM_ReadAll .
The supported NvM RAM block name shall be IdsM_NvMRamBlockData.
The supported NvM ROM block name shall be IdsM_NvMRomBlockData.
The diagnostic handling feature shall be optional. It shall be activated or deactivated with the parameter IdsMDiagnosticSupport .
The "Reporting Mode" IdsMReportingModeFilter of a SEv shall be modifiable during run-time via the diagnostic services of the Dcm .

The service IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall enable the IdsM to modify the reporting mode IdsMReportingModeFilter of a specific SEv . This service shall trigger the routine execution to modify the current reporting mode, and shall contain the new reporting mode value to be set.

In case the reporting mode parameter in IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start is invalid, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_REQUESTOUTOFRANGE as its Dcm negative response and the function shall return E_NOT_OK.

In case the Security Event Definition Id used for the call IdsM_Dcm_SetReportingMode_Start is invalid, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_REQUESTOUTOFRANGE as its Dcm negative response and the function shall return E_NOT_OK.
In case the request to NvM to persist the new reporting mode fails, this IdsM service shall return DCM_E_GENERALPROGRAMMINGFAILURE as its Dcm negative response and the function shall return E_NOT_OK.
In case the request to NvM to persist the new reporting mode fails, this IdsM service shall roll back to the previously configured reporting mode.
The "Reporting Mode" IdsMReportingModeFilter of a SEv shall be readable via the diagnostic services of the Dcm.
The service IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_Start called by the Dcm module shall trigger the IdsM 's routine execution to request the current reporting mode of a specific SEv .

The service IdsM_Dcm_GetReportingMode_RequestResults called by the Dcm module shall allow the IdsM to provide the routine results and reporting mode for the requested security event via a result pointer.

Ifl library shall not require initialization phase. A Library function may be called at the very first step of ECU initialization, e.g. even by the OS or EcuM, thus the library shall be ready.
Ifl library shall not require a shutdown operation phase.
The Ifl library shall be implemented in a way that the code can be shared among callers in different memory partitions.
Usage of macros should be avoided. The function should be declared as function or inline function. Macro #define should not be used.
A library function can call other library functions because all library functions shall be re-entrant. A library function shall not call any BSW modules functions, e.g. the DET.
The library, written in C programming language, should conform to the MISRA C Standard. Please refer to SWS_BSW_00115 for more details.
Each AUTOSAR library Module implementation <library>*.c and <library>*.h shall map their code to memory sections using the AUTOSAR memory mapping mechanism.
Each AUTOSAR library Module implementation <library>*.c, that uses AUTOSAR integer data types and/or the standard return, shall include the header file Std_Types.h.
All AUTOSAR library Modules should use the AUTOSAR data types (integers, boolean) instead of native C data types, unless this library is clearly identified to be compliant only with a platform.
All AUTOSAR library Modules should avoid direct use of compiler and platform specific keyword, unless this library is clearly identified to be compliant only with a platform. eg. #pragma, typeof etc.
